title: Library Administration
description:
Library Administration is the super-admin view across every lifecycle-managed object in Parthenon — concept sets, cohort definitions, and analyses — regardless of owner. From here you can promote drafts to active, archive stale items, restore from trash, reassign ownership when a user leaves, or permanently purge soft-deleted records.

The **Active** tab shows live items grouped by lifecycle status; the **Trash** tab shows soft-deleted items eligible for restore or hard delete.
tips: This view is restricted to super-admins and cuts across every user's items — handle other people's work with care.
Archive is a reversible soft delete (recoverable from the Trash tab); Purge is a permanent hard delete and cannot be undone.
Reassign Owner is the correct tool when off-boarding a researcher — it transfers items without losing history.
Use the Type filter and status tabs to narrow large libraries before running bulk actions.
Bulk lifecycle actions apply to every selected row — confirm the selection count in the toolbar before committing.
Lifecycle status (draft → active → archived) is shared with each user's own Library view; changes here are immediately visible to owners.
